quests.question: This person works in the forest, chopping and cutting logs.
quests.hint: This person works in the forest, chopping and cutting logs.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a lumberjack. Lumberjacks cut down trees to get wood for building.
quests.funFact: Lumberjacks plant new trees to help forests keep growing.
quests.wordExample: The lumberjack worked carefully in the tall forest.

quests.question: This person works on a ship and helps it sail across the sea.
quests.hint: This person works on a ship and helps it sail across the sea.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a sailor. Sailors work on a ship and help it travel across the sea.
quests.funFact: Sailors once used the stars at night to help steer their ship!
quests.wordExample: The sailor steered the ship through the calm sea.

quests.question: This person makes and serves coffee and other drinks at a cafe.
